t: Five high school biology units built on StarLogo Nova models.
steps: Open the BioGraph teacher materials in a browser.
Choose one of the five units that matches the course.
Open the linked StarLogo Nova model and run it yourself.
Check with IT whether students need StarLogo Nova accounts.
Read the StarLogo Nova privacy terms before students sign in.
Print or share the student materials for the unit.
Start with a short model run and a class discussion.
